scope: Conservative redistribution audit for representative dataset media in a private GitHub research/demo repository.
disclaimer: Engineering compliance triage, not legal advice. A private GitHub repository still reproduces files and may make them available to collaborators and a third-party cloud provider.

verdicts.bundle: Dataset media may be committed under the stated license and conditions.
verdicts.conditional_bundle: Commit only the specifically identified licensed material and only when every stated condition is met.
verdicts.verbatim_only: Only an unmodified original file may be shared; do not trim, crop, transcode, annotate, montage, or convert to GIF.
verdicts.external_only: Do not commit media bytes; retain an official source link, iframe, manifest entry, or user-side downloader.

global_rules: A public project-page teaser is not automatically covered by the dataset license.
For gated datasets, each user should accept the official terms and download into a gitignored directory.
For CC BY and CC BY-NC material, preserve creator, source URL, license URL, and change notices.
Do not assume a noncommercial license is safe for a company repository or a demo connected to product development or commercial advantage.
When license sources conflict, follow the stricter terms until the rightsholder clarifies them.

datasets.name: Ropedia Xperience-10M
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for xperience-10m-sample; full dataset is gated with license tag 'other'
datasets.bundle_scope: Only files or derivatives from ropedia-ai/xperience-10m-sample, for noncommercial use with attribution and change notice
datasets.handling: Use the public sample for the gallery. Keep the full dataset as an application/download link only.

datasets.name: HA-Ego-1K
datasets.license: Dataset metadata reports CC BY-NC 4.0, but the gated click-through terms were not publicly retrievable
datasets.bundle_scope: None until the accepted gate terms are archived and confirmed not to restrict redistribution
datasets.handling: Link to the access request; do not republish files obtained by an approved account.

datasets.name: ACE-Data-0
datasets.license: ACE-Data-0 Research License; noncommercial academic research, personal and non-transferable, explicit no redistribution
datasets.access: Gated; each collaborator must request access individually
datasets.bundle_scope: None
datasets.handling: Do not commit raw data, frames, clips, or derived visualizations. Project-page preview media has no separate redistribution grant.

datasets.name: Ego-Exo4D
datasets.license: Signed Ego-Exo4D license agreement with restrictions on redistribution and other activities
datasets.access: Approval and temporary AWS credentials required
datasets.bundle_scope: None under the conservative audit
datasets.handling: Keep official site, visualizer, and CLI links. Download approved data outside Git.

datasets.name: Aria Digital Twin (ADT)
datasets.license: Project Aria ADT License; prohibits distributing the Dataset and derived works and prohibits public display or performance without prior written permission
datasets.bundle_scope: None
datasets.handling: Do not commit frames, clips, GIFs, screenshots, or locally rendered visualizations. Link to the official viewer and downloader.

datasets.name: EgoHTR
datasets.license: No dataset or media redistribution license located
datasets.access: Project page labels dataset and code as staged/coming soon
datasets.bundle_scope: None
datasets.handling: Use official explorer links only; do not vendor the explorer MP4s.

datasets.name: Ego-1K
datasets.license: FAIR Noncommercial Research License
datasets.bundle_scope: Noncommercial research only; distribution and derivatives must remain under the same agreement and include a copy of it
datasets.handling: Include the full FAIR license and citation. Use a downloader instead if the repository belongs to a commercial project or company context that is not clearly noncommercial.

datasets.name: Ego-OSCAR / Stereo-550
datasets.license: FPV Labs custom dataset license; official card says commercial usage is allowed but does not expose a verifiable redistribution grant
datasets.bundle_scope: None until the exact accepted license authorizes redistribution
datasets.handling: Do not infer redistribution permission from commercial-use permission. Keep the access request and downloader only.

datasets.name: CoMind
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0
datasets.access: Official download script and public samples
datasets.bundle_scope: Dataset files and derivatives, including commercial use, with attribution, license link, and change notice
datasets.handling: Prefer an actual dataset sample. Do not assume unrelated website decorations or third-party assets are covered.

datasets.name: EgoBody
datasets.license: Signed research-use dataset license; no public blanket redistribution grant located
datasets.bundle_scope: None
datasets.handling: Keep the application link. Treat project-page teaser media as external-only unless separately licensed in writing.

datasets.name: HOI4D
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0
datasets.bundle_scope: Noncommercial dataset media and derivatives with attribution, license link, and change notice
datasets.handling: Do not use in a commercial or product demo without separate permission.

datasets.name: SHOW3D
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 on the current official dataset card
datasets.bundle_scope: Noncommercial released dataset files and derivatives with attribution, license link, and change notice
datasets.handling: Pin the source commit and audit date because the repository evolved during its release process.

datasets.name: Assembly101
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0
datasets.access: Public official samples; full distribution uses an access/download workflow
datasets.bundle_scope: Prefer the public official sample files for a noncommercial demo, with attribution, license link, and change notice
datasets.handling: Use the official downloader for the full dataset rather than mirroring it.

datasets.name: HD-EPIC
datasets.license: Conflicting official metadata: Bristol repository says CC BY 4.0; official Codabench challenge says CC BY-NC 4.0
datasets.bundle_scope: Treat all media as CC BY-NC 4.0 until clarified; noncommercial use only, with attribution and change notice
datasets.handling: Record both license sources in the attribution manifest. Obtain author confirmation before commercial use.

datasets.name: InterVLA
datasets.license: No dataset or media license located
datasets.access: Project page is public; linked data/code release was unavailable during the audit
datasets.bundle_scope: None
datasets.handling: Link to the project page and paper. Do not copy project figures or infer a license.

datasets.name: EgoDex
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-ND for the dataset; repository code has a separate Apple software license
datasets.bundle_scope: Only an exact, unmodified original dataset file for noncommercial sharing with attribution
datasets.handling: Do not trim, crop, transcode, overlay annotations, create a montage, or convert to GIF. For a short preview, use an external link or obtain written permission.

datasets.name: Open-AoE
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 covers original source code; dataset is tagged 'other' and has no verifiable redistribution grant
datasets.bundle_scope: Code may be reused under Apache-2.0; dataset video, frames, and derived visualizations may not be bundled under this audit
datasets.handling: Keep data as remote links or a downloader. Preserve Apache notices for reused code.

datasets.name: HumanEgo
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 as of the 2026-06-08 relicensing commit; Project Aria terms also apply
datasets.bundle_scope: Noncommercial dataset media and derivatives with attribution, license link, change notice, and responsible-use compliance
datasets.handling: Pin the relicensing commit and include the dataset citation and Project Aria notices. Commercial use requires a separate license.

datasets.name: Aria Everyday Activities (AEA)
datasets.license: Project Aria AEA License; prohibits distributing the Dataset and derived works and prohibits public display or performance without prior written permission
datasets.bundle_scope: None
datasets.handling: Do not commit frames, clips, GIFs, screenshots, or rendered trajectories. Link to the official viewer and downloader.

datasets.name: EgoPAT3D
datasets.license: MIT applies to repository code; the externally hosted dataset has no explicit redistribution license and the project site says all rights reserved
datasets.access: Processed download link; raw MKV by email request
datasets.bundle_scope: Code only under MIT; not dataset bytes or project-site media
datasets.handling: Keep official download links or a user-side downloader. Obtain written permission before copying dataset media or the project GIF.
